podcast.title: Keyboard Player's Demise
podcast.body: The keyboard player for Yummy Fur, who notably wore a Canadian flag t-shirt in a video, committed suicide in 1999. "Oddly retro-electronica from the pre-Franc band called Yummy Fur in the video of the keyboard players wearing a Canadian flag t-shirt. He committed suicide in 1999."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Franz Ferdinand: In Their Own Words

podcast.title: Meeting Point for Alex Kapranos and Paul Thompson
podcast.body: Yummy Fur was the band where Alex Kapranos and Paul Thompson first met and played together, forming a connection that would later lead to Franz Ferdinand. "Yummy Fur came next. This is where Alex met Paul, and they sounded like this."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
